title: Lukas Jung
text:
I am a PhD student in psychology at University of Bern, working on forensic metascience.
My work focuses on developing, implementing, and validating statistical methods to check published work for errors. I wrote the scrutiny R package for the GRIM and GRIMMER tests.

Publications

scrutiny: Error detection in science
Jung, L. (2025). R package version 0.6.1 [Computer software]. https://lhdjung.github.io/scrutiny/


unsum: Reconstruct raw data from summary statistics
Jung, L. (2025). R package version 0.2.0 [Computer software]. https://lhdjung.github.io/unsum/


Position Paper: Corrections Not Found - Post-Publication Integrity in Usable Security and Privacy Research
Borgert, N., Jansen, L., Jung, L., Halbritter, T., & Elson, M. (2026). 2026 IEEE Symposium on Security and Privacy Workshops (SPW), 345–350. https://doi.org/10.1109/SPW72489.2026.00043


Assessing the feasibility and impact of clinical trial trustworthiness checks via an application to Cochrane Reviews: Stage 2 of the INSPECT-SR project
Wilkinson, J., Heal, C., Antoniou, G. A., …, Jung, L., …, Kirkham, J. J. (2025). Journal of Clinical Epidemiology, 184, 111824. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jclinepi.2025.111824


INSPECT-SR: A tool for assessing trustworthiness of randomised controlled trials
Wilkinson, J., Heal, C., Flemyng, E., …, Jung, L., …, Kirkham, J. J. (2025). medRxiv. https://doi.org/10.1101/2025.09.03.25334905
